topic.title: Investment Zones / Special Tax Sites / Delivery Governance
topic.source_contract: Investment Zone designation, sector focus, special tax site, governance, intervention plan, funding, planning route, subsidy control, land and infrastructure, business occupation, employment, evaluation and compliance evidence

scope_guards: An Investment Zone policy announcement is not treated as a designated special tax site.
A designated tax site is not treated as planning consent.
A funding envelope is not treated as a signed project funding agreement.
A planning offer is not treated as permission for a development.
A business expression of interest is not treated as occupation.
An employment target is not treated as measured jobs.
Tax eligibility is not treated as long-term business performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact designation, agreement, consent, delivery, occupation and evaluation evidence.
